incidents.name: Ekubo
incidents.notes: Ekubo's lock/forward/withdraw/pay flow let an attacker withdraw core-held WBTC and settle the debt via pay() using the victim's approval, abusing the router's flawed settlement.

sources.ref: re-check 2026 (deployment-basis rows with a DELEGATECALL in the runtime): CONFIRMED deployment basis. The runtime is byte-identical at the creation block 23297576 and the incident block 25030409, and callTracer on the exploit tx shows 255 frames executing at the victim with zero DELEGATECALL out of its context; the 0xf4 bytes a naive scan flags are all in the trailing data region (pc 20745+ of 22508).
